newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker buyers sidelined, prices steady.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker buyers sidelined, prices steady.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications were steady from Wednesday as most shipowners were adopting a "wait and see" stance before covering their requirements, traders said on Thursday.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $122-$123 per tonne and 180-cst at $127-$128 per tonne, around a dollar higher from Wednesday.

Traders said most buyers were waiting to see how cargo prices would move later Thursday before buying. Others said bad weather have also dampened buying interest as barges face difficulty moving alongside ships.
MDO went up on cargo, quoted at $233, gasoil at $240-$246.
